scope: Client shared invoice preparation and review cancellation; no deployed backend/policy changes.
preparation: Existing basket starts preparation from home/restaurant/cart when account and saved destination are available
Single-flight whole-invoice requests and independent single-flight route lookup
Same valid destination quote reused for quantity/tip/benefit changes
No empty-basket final fee invented on app launch

cache.lifetime: Server supplied expiry only, never extended locally
cache.storage: Volatile memory,12 invoices and12 route quotes; bounded retry records
scope: saved address identity and exact coordinates
cache.displayMetadata: Address/store label formatting does not generate another price request
cache.refresh: Foreground quiet refresh near expiry; valid displayed snapshot survives refresh failure; quote expiry still blocks approval. Background requests have their own read-only controller.
cache.retry: Cooldown prevents repeated request loops; minimum-order hint is separate from a network error.

checkout: Cart displays effective service and final total from shared authoritative invoice
Checkout reuses prepared quote/invoice; no extra storefront pricing request
Review uses unexpired matching prepared proposal/request ID; no redundant preview merely to open or close review
Review dismissal returns cancelled=true and no error notification, pending attempt, order or offer reservation
Fresh reviewed proposal feeds same shared invoice displayed underneath
Final order request retains original server consent digest, quote/agreement/policy/catalog/funding/version fences
Expired context renews; definite precommit rejections invalidate cached snapshot; ambiguous results retain original pending recovery
Successful order clears shared price cache

tests.newServerCases: NONE/MERCHANT/PLATFORM delivery funding: same prepared price/request ID survives final customer/store metadata and replay creates exactly one mocked order
coverage: retain valid snapshot after refresh failure
close/reopen review with zero additional preview/order requests
final-send-only HTTP request and ambiguous-result pending retention
OrderService dismissal is not an error
tests.verification: All financial writes are mocked. No real order, wallet movement or discount usage performed for tests.
tests.analyzer: No errors or warnings in changed files; informational style findings remain.

limitations: A first uncached price still needs server response; only actual basket/eligible agreement inputs produce a final service charge. Expiry or material input changes require a new validated invoice.
